mapper.select: SELECT id, name FROM patient_basic_info WHERE UPPER(TRIM(card_no)) = UPPER(TRIM(#{cardNo})) ORDER BY id

SELECT r.id, r.doctor_id AS doctorId, u.name AS doctorName, r.research_type AS researchType, CASE WHEN r.research_type IN () THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isRa FROM patient_relation_doctor r LEFT JOIN `user` u ON u.id = r.doctor_id WHERE r.patient_id = #{patientId} ORDER BY r.id

SELECT p.name, p.card_no AS cardNo, p.gender, p.mobile, p.nation, p.marry, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.confirm_date, p.confirmDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS confirmDate, DATE_FORMAT(COALESCE(p.happen_date, p.happenDate), '%Y-%m-%d') AS happenDate, p.height, p.weight, p.waistline, p.xl AS heartRate, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.xy_h, ''), p.xy) AS systolic, p.xy_l AS diastolic, p.smoke, COALESCE(p.smoke_years, p.smokeYears) AS smokeYears, COALESCE(p.smoke_count_by_day, p.smokeCountByDay) AS smokeCountByDay, COALESCE(p.smoke_stop, p.smokeStop) AS smokeStop, p.gms AS allergyHistory, p.jzs AS familyHistory, p.jws AS pastHistory, p.follow_cycle AS followCycle, p.study_no AS studyNo FROM patient_basic_info p WHERE p.id = #{patientId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_basic_info (name, card_no, gender, age, mobile, nation, marry, confirm_date, happen_date, height, weight, waistline, xl, xy, xy_h, xy_l, smoke, smoke_years, smoke_count_by_day, smoke_stop, gms, jzs, jws, acr_eular_score, create_date, follow_up_count, study_no, follow_cycle) VALUES (#{name}, #{cardNo}, #{gender}, #{age}, #{mobile}, #{nation}, #{marry}, #{confirmDate}, #{happenDate}, #{height}, #{weight}, #{waistline}, #{xl}, #{xy_h}, #{xy_h}, #{xy_l}, #{smoke}, #{smokeYears}, #{smokeCountByDay}, #{smokeStop}, #{gms}, #{jzs}, #{jws}, #{acrEularScore}, NOW(), 0, #{studyNo}, #{followCycle})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM patient_basic_info WHERE study_no LIKE CONCAT(#{prefix}, '%')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_relation_doctor (create_date, doctor_id, patient_id, research_type, confirm_date, happen_date, follow_count, miss, revisit, last_verify_status) VALUES (NOW(), #{doctorId}, #{patientId}, #{researchType}, #{confirmDate}, #{happenDate}, 0, 0, 0, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE patient_relation_doctor SET doctor_id = #{doctorId}, update_date = NOW() WHERE id = #{relationId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO patient_acr_eular (patient_id, joint_score, serology_score, duration_score, acute_score, total_score, doctor_id) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{jointScore}, #{serologyScore}, #{durationScore}, #{acuteScore}, #{totalScore}, #{doctorId})
INSERT IGNORE INTO patient_comorbidity (patient_id, disease_code, since_year, source, linked_patient_id) VALUES (#{patientId}, #{code}, #{sinceYear}, #{source}, #{linkedPatientId})
